datasets.notes: Pinned June 2026 coordinated community release; publisher SHA-256 verified. Parsed 5,589 questions, 2,509 accepted answers, and 3,779 other positively scored answers into 11,877 post documents and 13,531 chunks with exact per-post citations. datasets.notes: Pinned June 2026 coordinated community release; publisher SHA-256 verified. The 271,298,857-byte archive expanded to 1,313,984,676 bytes. Parsed 70,265 questions, 32,426 accepted answers, and 68,350 other positively scored answers into 171,041 post documents and 188,770 chunks. The 18-topic lexical and final routed exact-query gates achieved Success@1/5/10, MRR@10, Recall@5/10/50, and nDCG@10 of 1.0. A verified 256-dimensional Qwen3-Embedding generation covers every chunk in 287,344,685 bytes of vector and metadata files. On 14 pooled paraphrase judgments, strict-AND BM25 found no relevant evidence while hybrid retrieval achieved Success@1 0.357143, Success@5 0.857143, Success@10 0.928571, Recall@50 0.704762, and MRR@10 0.53869. Reranking preserved Success@10 but slightly lowered Success@5, so automatic routing keeps terse technical phrases on strict BM25 while broader questions use hybrid retrieval.

datasets.scope: complete official GNU C Preprocessor 16.2 manual, one HTML page per node
datasets.notes: Pinned to GCC's official 16.2 release documentation page. The 109,792-byte archive has local SHA-256 b96bc25f0a16619a99b91fcc6f3cefdefcc859a1ebff9f99ab804ba560e89dae; GCC supplied no adjacent archive digest, so tar structure and 80 extracted files / 625,629 bytes were validated. Retrieval excludes the duplicate top page and generated directive, option, and concept indexes. The remaining 76 manual nodes produced 183 chunks and a 659,456-byte verified BM25 database. The 30-topic lexical gate covers preprocessing phases, headers, macros, conditionals, directives, output, compatibility, implementation, and invocation, with every metric cutoff at 1.0.
